en.title: My reports
en.note: Your reports and review decisions are private. Reporting does not automatically remove a listing or message.
en.detailsHint: Describe the issue. Do not include passwords or payment details.
en.failed: The report was not confirmed. Your text is still here; try again.
en.appealNote: Explain why the decision should be reviewed. Submitting an appeal does not change the current restriction.
en.appealFailed: The appeal was not confirmed. Try again with the same text.
en.unavailable: Reports are currently unavailable. Try again later.
en.noHistory: No moderation decisions for this listing.
en.receipt: This receipt is saved to your account.

bg.title: Моите сигнали
bg.note: Сигналите и решенията по тях са лични. Подаването на сигнал не премахва автоматично обява или съобщение.
bg.detailsHint: Опиши проблема. Не включвай пароли или данни за плащане.

bg.unavailable: Сигналите временно не са достъпни. Опитай отново по-късно.
